title: JA Vega wp7 1.1.10: service-card and related excerpts cut at 3 lines, the Continue Reading band is 24/32 px tall above the pill, and small text is .875em like the source
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout read the shipped theme packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/wp-ja-vega (style.css, assets/css/wp-ja-vega.css) and its overlay under overlays/wp-ja-vega.

S2: Read the release's recorded site sweep tasks/ja-vega-wp7/release/fix-measure.json (taken on a clean restore of the 1.1.10 pack against the local Joomla source stand) and tasks/ja-vega-wp7/release/SHA256SUMS.
expect: S1: the theme is version 1.1.10; the shipped stylesheet and the overlay both clamp service-card and related excerpts to 3 lines, pad the Continue Reading band 24 px from 576 and 32 px from 992, and size small text .875em.
S2: the sweep was taken by site-sweep.mjs on the released theme zip, passes 11 of 11 checks with 0 heights defects, and its baseline is 1.1.9 with heights failing.
evidence: Sweeps of 06/10/2026 against the local Joomla source stand: the 1.1.9 restore had 10/11 checks passing (heights: 16 groups, 272 cases); the 1.1.10 build stand has 11/11 (heights: 0 open, 13 accepted), measure117 12/12, measure118 20/20, measure116 5/5 + 3/3; release chain on the clean restore of the packed 1.1.10 site: 11/11, heights 0 open, 13 accepted, 0 not measured
fence: The shipped stylesheet carries the three rules and the release's sweep record is the one taken on the shipped zip; the script goes red on the parent of the fix (13 of 14 checks).
